exposure: Program to decrease the number of Caesarean sections
Intensive interventional program to decrease obstetric anal sphincter injuries
outcome: Number of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS)
Rate of OASIS for instrumental deliveries
cohort: Pregnant women receiving care at a single clinic.
finding: An intensive interventional program significantly decreased the frequency of OASIS and the rate of Caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The rate of OASIS for instrumental deliveries (mostly by vacuum) decreased significantly, while OASIS and Grade 4 sphincter injuries increased with forceps delivery.
